task: Provision the real portal cosign public key in the Kyverno signature policy and air-gap bundle after the signing secrets moved to dasomel/narwhal

events.summary: Replace only the two placeholder publicKeys PEM blocks; keep verify-image-signatures in Audit with required:false so no workload admission changes.
Policy carried a non-PEM placeholder key and dasomel/narwhal had no COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY/COSIGN_PASSWORD, so the first portal/v* release would fail at the sign job and signatures could never verify.

Key pair generated locally, sign/verify roundtrip passed before the secrets were set, private key wiped; committed cosign.pub inlined in both attestors; R74 now fails closed on missing key or inline drift (R75c mutation test).
Static regression suite 371 passed 0 failed, including R74, R75, R75b and R75c; missing-key case exits 1.
make validate parsed every GitOps YAML file including the edited kyverno-policies.yaml.
Static key provisioning done; actual image signing, GHCR push permission and Kyverno verification against a signed portal image remain unverified until the first portal/v* release.
Static guards verified; policy stays Audit, no live cluster mutation.
